reason: 该插件在 README 与插件配置中明确定位为“文件收发桥”，核心能力是为 DSH 对话场景提供附件上传、agent 下发文件链接/预览，以及通过可点击路径在侧边栏 explorer 打开文件，并配套 `/dsh-files/*` 只读静态服务，因此其主要用户场景是文件传输与文件访问辅助，不属于代码生成、搜索、研究或图形可视化类插件。

summaries.zh: DSH 文件收发桥插件可在对话中实现附件上传与文件下发，并支持在消息中点击路径快速打开侧边栏 explorer。
summaries.en: The DSH file bridge plugin enables chat-based file upload and agent file delivery, with clickable path mentions that open files in the sidebar explorer.

capabilities: user-to-agent file uploads from the chat UI
path-based explorer launch from response text

reasons.code: read-only static serving for shared file directory
filesystem path mention handling to open explorer
UI attachment upload flow for images and general files
